body:
susanj1111@aol.com (SusanJ1111) shook herself out of
a Prozac-induced haze and typed:
>
>Agent99 quoted me:
>
>>"The rest of your post should earn you a pen register 
>>with the FBI, if you don't already have one. A recent 
>>post would have done the same thing. Three cheers for 
>>the FBI, who may still be monitoring this group."
>>--susanj1111@aol.com (SusanJ1111) to 99 in message 
>><19990813194840.04868.00001045@ng-cm1.aol.com>,
>>displaying her committment to free speech.
>
>Yes, Agent99, I do believe that people who advocate the killing of other
>people
>from behind the safety of an anonymous screen name are worth having a look
>at.

So you have no confidence in ECHELON after all? ;-)

>I believe that murderers belong in jail too. I am for free speech and against
>conspiracy to murder. Is that PC, Agent99?

Yes, sweetie, it's very PC.

You're an American KGB wannabe, Suze.  You
wouldn't recognize free speech if it bit you
on the ass.

>
>Now, a pen register should not trouble you if you really are a nice guy deep
>down with no evil plans. I guess that's why you are still so upset about
>this.

This sort of comment is exactly why you are the
antithesis of everything an anarchist is about,
little Suze.  I'll wager it would have drawn
the special contempt of TK -- an extra gob of
mucus in his spittle for you.  The idea that
ANY police tactic is OK with a citizen who "has
no evil plans" is a totalitarian one.  You'd 
have been quite at home in Stalin's Russia.

>
>You were defending Furrow, and said that his rampage was a good start. 

Actually, I criticized Furrow.  If he had as much
weaponry as the press claimed, he definitely should 
have killed more kikes.

>You
>have
>also posted about how good the world would be if there were no Jews. Can you
>explain how this is supposed to happen? Do you suppose that you are going to
>convince your enemies to commit mass suicide? (The phrase bored to death
>takes
>on a new meaning).

To find out how it will happen, you'll have to
read ISAIF. 

>
>You do realize that this newsgroup may have been founded by the FBI, don't
>you?

You see?  You're a wannabe.  How despicable.

>Or are you that stupid?

Stupid is as stupid does, huh Suze? <g>
Like the other guy said, you're WEIRD.

>
>-Susan
>
>"... They would seek other, dangerous outlets (drugs, crime, "cults," hate
>groups)..." Paragraph 176, ISAIF.
>

Cheers,
99
